seed: The blue buttons that end a mode (Adjust Grid's Done, Crop), photographed with the window behind another app (the way every walk leaves it) in light and then dark: each is a grey pill with dark words in light and light words in dark, never white words on a near-white pill. Before 2026-10-09 the system's blue button nearly vanished there in light mode. With the window in front they stay the blue button.

steps.note: Adjust Grid's bar in light mode, window behind another app: Done is a grey pill with dark words beside Cancel
the same bar in dark mode: Done is a grey pill with light words
Crop's Cancel and Crop capsule in light mode, window behind: Crop is a grey pill with dark words
